definitions.explanation: A round bulb vegetable with layers, used widely in cooking.

examples.japanese: {玉葱|たまねぎ}を{切|き}ると{涙|なみだ}が{出|で}る。
examples.english: When I cut onions, tears come out.

examples.japanese: {玉葱|たまねぎ}を{炒|いた}めて{飴色|あめいろ}にする。
カレーには{玉葱|たまねぎ}が{欠|か}かせない。

notes:
{玉葱|たまねぎ} is one of the most commonly used vegetables in cooking.

COMMON PREPARATIONS:
- みじん{切|ぎ}り: diced/minced
- {薄切|うすぎ}り: thinly sliced
- {飴色|あめいろ}{玉葱|たまねぎ}: caramelized onion

VARIETIES:
- {新|しん}{玉葱|たまねぎ}: new onion (spring, sweeter)
- {赤|あか}{玉葱|たまねぎ}: red onion

KANJI: Literally means 'ball onion,' distinguishing it from 葱 (green onion).
